svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Heron Station: map
svg.desc: Plan of Heron Station: one deck. Every room carries its name, doors wear their department's colour and the key machines are marked. The same rooms are listed below the picture.
svg.text: 75 rooms. Floors and doors are coloured by the department that holds the key.

g.text: One deck, in orbit: weightless outside the tubes
